mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate signals an end to tightening, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during easing cycles, or the 20d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers a surge in consumer confidence and investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing below 4.5%, or the rate does not cross the threshold in the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion, reducing uncertainty and elevating equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are negative despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in the federal funds rate below 4.5% signals impending peak inflation, prompting market anticipation of rate cuts and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns fail to rise during late-cycle expansions when FEDFUNDS drops below 4.5%, or the condition is not met in the data.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening regime, a sustained drop in UNRATE below 5.0% signals reduced labor supply, prompting corporate cost-cutting and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are positive despite UNRATE remaining above 5.0% in the tightening regime, or the rate does not drop sufficiently.
